audit_method: The provider artifact SHA-256 was recomputed locally. The copied source archive SHA-256 was recomputed and compared with acquisition.json. scope: Pinned source provenance and license reviewed; no CPython build, Percol PTY scenario, public authoring route, or project admission credit.
